description: Bridge USDT (USDT0) across chains (eth/arbitrum/mantle/monad/xlayer) via LayerZero OFT, from the Agent Wallet to the SAME wallet's address on the destination. Mode C (server-managed wallet). Sandbox-by-default; a live bridge needs confirm:true + consentToken. For USDC use q402_bridge_send (CCIP).

amount.description: USDT0 amount in raw local-decimal units (6-decimal; '1000000' = 1 USDT0).

confirm.description: Must be true for a live bridge.

walletId.description: Optional Agent Wallet id; defaults to the owner's default wallet.

name: q402_oft_send
